description: Use when a Storybook story for a controlled component is frozen — picking an option, deleting a chip, typing, or toggling fires onChange but nothing on screen changes. Applies to any story whose component takes a value prop plus an onChange callback (inputs, selects, multi-selects, checkboxes, radio groups, autocompletes, date pickers) and to stories wired only to an action logger.
